title: jig UI design tokens
description: jig's token table in the W3C Design Tokens (DTCG) JSON format: groups nest, a token is an object with $value. Color tokens are read for colors, dimension tokens (px) for the font sizes of typography roles. The jig extension adds the theme values and the names by which the code refers to the token. A file listed in ui.tokens, or the stdout of ui.tokens.command.

oneOf.description: A group of tokens and groups

$value.description: A color: a color string (#RGB, #RRGGBB, #RRGGBBAA, rgb(), rgba()) or a DTCG color object with hex. A dimension: 12px, a number of px, or a DTCG object {value, unit: px}. Either may be an alias {group.token}

themes.description: Theme name (as in ui.themes) to the value in that theme; a color string or an alias

refs.description: The names by which code refers to the token (e.g. a variable name or a dotted key); jig finds them by a literal search
